content:
SpaceXAI's Grok Bot has fueled a summer frenzy for consumer-facing AI agent apps. Facing competition from Meta's Muse and OpenAI's ChatGPT Dot, Grok Bot has received a brand-new feature upgrade with the help of Anthropic's Claude.

Grok Bot now uses Claude Opus 5.5 as its intelligence engine

Grok Bot launched in August with dedicated iPhone and iPad apps. The iPad version and a more affordable subscription plan followed in September.

Heading into October, Grok Bot is set for a major backend upgrade, swapping out the less capable model from SpaceXAI/Cursor for Anthropic's Claude as its intelligence core.

For background: Anthropic became a SpaceX customer this year while it was looking for compute resources to power Claude.

Starting today, Grok Bot can leverage Claude Opus 5.5, one of Anthropic's newest and most powerful models.

The timing of Grok Bot's upgrade comes as Meta is aggressively pushing its near-free Muse agent (which recently also landed on iPad), while OpenAI is also actively expanding its proactive agent ChatGPT Dot, powered by Astra.

Grok Bot is available on iPhone, iPad and Mac. Have you used any of the above-mentioned AI agent systems?
